bound_to.description:

CapabilityDescriptor.description:
A capability contract. `availability` is the only runtime-resolved field:
the exported catalog declares what a capability depends on (a matrix row
or a provider slot), and Core fills in what is actually offered.

provider.description:

served catalog names the entry: `hostd:<entry_id>`.

resource_scope.description:

entry point, and an empty scope would be an unreviewed default.

UnavailableReason.description:

specific product sentence for every value.

AvatarCorner.description: Where on its output the character sits.

corner.description:
Which corner of that output the character sits in. A corner is always
inside the visible area, whatever size the output has.

output.description:
The output the character stays on, by connector name. Absent means
it follows the primary output; so does a named output that is not
connected (unplugged), until it comes back. Absent fields are left out
of the document, so a Profile written before they existed keeps its
digest.

area.description:
The multi-entry area this entry is a member of (one of `AREAS`).
Absent means none, and is left out of the document, so a Profile
written before areas existed keeps its digest.

entry_id.description:
`ent-<ULID>`, generated by Core and stable across revisions: without a
stable id every edit would look like a removal plus an addition.

LayoutIntent.description: Layout intent. Which strategy applies is the `layout.strategy` slot.

regions.description:
Where windows of an application go, as a share of their output's work
area (D-40). Applied to the windows open when the change commits and to
those that open later; moving a window by hand afterwards is respected
until the next explicit change. Floating strategy only.

output.description:

output the window is on.

string is rejected, never parsed).
